summary.headline: Venus Occultation in the Signs
summary.text: Astrological judgments for the occultation of Mars in Aquarius and Pisces, followed by Venus’s general effects and sign-by-sign predictions from Aries through Scorpio, including rain, wind, cold, divorce, illness, political disorder, and social upheaval. A warning explains that occultations before combustion occur on the western side near the horizon.
